tree.cn: 我最喜爱的中国菜——宫保鸡丁

children.text: Introduction (Name & Flavor)
children.cn: 菜名与风味简介

children.text: Chinese food is famous all over the world, and my favorite dish is Kung Pao Chicken.
children.cn: 中国美食闻名世界，我最喜爱的菜是宫保鸡丁。
children.notes: be famous all over the world: 闻名全世界; favorite dish: 最喜爱的菜肴
children.statement: “all over the world” 意为“全世界”。
children.explanation: all over the world 是固定短语，表示“全世界、全球”。
children.keywords: Chinese food, famous, all over the world, Kung Pao Chicken

children.text: It is a classic Sichuan dish that tastes sweet, sour, and a little spicy.
children.cn: 这是一道经典的川菜，尝起来酸甜可口，带有一点微辣。
children.notes: classic: 经典的; taste: 尝起来（连系动词）; sweet, sour and spicy: 甜、酸和辣
children.statement: “tastes” 在本句中是感官系动词，后面接形容词作表语。
children.explanation: taste 作为感官系动词，意为“尝起来”，后接形容词 sweet, sour, spicy 作表语。
children.keywords: classic, Sichuan dish, tastes sweet, sour, spicy

children.text: Ingredients & Instructions
children.cn: 所需食材与烹饪步骤

children.text: To make this delicious dish, we need chicken breast, peanuts, cucumber, ginger, and garlic.
children.cn: 制作这道美味的菜肴，我们需要鸡胸肉、花生、黄瓜、生姜和大蒜。
children.notes: To make: 不定式作目的状语; chicken breast: 鸡胸肉; peanuts: 花生; ginger and garlic: 姜蒜
children.statement: “To make this delicious dish” 在句中作目的状语。
children.explanation: 动词不定式短语置于句首常用来表达做某事的目的。
children.keywords: To make, chicken breast, peanuts, ginger, garlic

children.text: First, cut the chicken and vegetables into small pieces.
children.cn: 首先，把鸡肉和蔬菜切成小块。
children.notes: cut... into small pieces: 把……切成小块（祈使句）
children.statement: “cut into pieces” 是“切成小块/片”的意思。
children.explanation: cut ... into small pieces 是烹饪指令中的核心短语。

children.text: Next, heat some oil in a pot and add the ginger and garlic.
children.cn: 接下来，在锅里热一些油，加入生姜和大蒜。
children.notes: heat oil in a pot: 在锅中热油; add... to...: 添加……
children.explanation: pot 表示烹饪用的锅，在 a pot 中为单数形式。
children.keywords: Next, heat oil, in a pot, add, ginger and garlic

children.text: Then, stir-fry the chicken and add soy sauce, vinegar, and cooking wine.
children.cn: 然后，翻炒鸡肉，并加入酱油、醋和料酒。
children.notes: stir-fry: 翻炒; soy sauce: 酱油; vinegar: 醋; cooking wine: 料酒
children.explanation: stir-fry 是中餐烹饪中常用的动词，表示在热油中快速翻炒。
children.keywords: stir-fry, chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, cooking wine

children.text: Finally, put in the peanuts and mix everything together.
children.cn: 最后，放入花生，把所有东西混合搅拌均匀。
children.notes: put in: 放入; mix... together: 混合在一起
children.statement: “Finally” 用来引出最后一步操作。
children.explanation: 顺序副词 Finally 常置于句首，用于列举序列的最后一项。
children.keywords: Finally, put in, peanuts, mix together

children.text: Reasons & Feelings
children.cn: 喜爱原因与文化感悟

children.text: I love this dish because it is both delicious and easy to prepare.
children.cn: 我喜欢这道菜，因为它既美味又容易做。
children.notes: both... and...: 既……又……; easy to prepare: 容易准备/制作
children.statement: “both... and...” 连接两个并列的形容词 delicious 和 easy。
children.explanation: both... and... 是并列连词短语，此处连接作表语的两个形容词。
children.keywords: love this dish, because, both delicious and easy

children.text: Cooking Chinese food helps me understand our rich traditional culture.
children.cn: 烹饪中国菜帮助我了解我们丰富的传统文化。
children.notes: help sb. do sth.: 帮助某人做某事; rich traditional culture: 丰富的传统文化
children.statement: 句首动名词短语 “Cooking Chinese food” 在本句中作主语。
children.explanation: 动名词短语作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式 helps。
children.keywords: Cooking Chinese food, helps understand, traditional culture

tree.cn: 我最喜爱的中国菜——宫保鸡丁 (高分进阶)

children.text: Introduction (Cultural Heritage & Name)
children.cn: 文化底蕴与名菜引出

children.text: As a treasure of Chinese traditional culture, Chinese cuisine is well-known around the world.
children.cn: 作为中华传统文化的瑰宝，中国菜肴在全世界享有盛名。
children.notes: treasure of...: ……的瑰宝; Chinese cuisine: 中国烹饪/中国菜; well-known: 著名的
children.statement: “well-known” 与 “famous” 同义，意为“著名的，众所周知的”。
children.explanation: well-known 是合成形容词，作表语表示享誉世界。
children.keywords: treasure, traditional culture, Chinese cuisine, well-known

children.text: Among all the traditional dishes, Kung Pao Chicken is definitely my favorite homemade dish.
children.cn: 在所有的传统菜肴中，宫保鸡丁绝对是我最喜爱的家常菜。
children.notes: Among all...: 在所有……之中; definitely: 毫无疑问地，绝对; homemade dish: 家常菜
children.statement: “Among” 用于三者或三者以上的“在……之中”。
children.explanation: among 用于三者或以上范围，between 通常用于两者之间。
children.keywords: Among all, Kung Pao Chicken, definitely, favorite homemade dish

children.text: It is famous for its bright color and a perfect mix of sweet, sour, and spicy flavors.
children.cn: 它以其鲜艳的色泽以及酸甜香辣的完美结合而闻名遐迩。
children.notes: be famous for: 因……而著名; a perfect mix of: ……的完美融合; flavors: 风味
children.statement: “be famous for” 意为“因……而著名”。
children.explanation: be famous for 后面接著名原因或特色，be famous as 后接身份或地位。
children.keywords: famous for, bright color, perfect mix, sweet, sour, spicy flavors

children.text: Ingredients & Step-by-step Instructions
children.cn: 精选原料与烹饪步骤

children.text: To prepare this dish, we need fresh chicken breast, crispy peanuts, ginger, garlic, and onions.
children.cn: 要准备这道菜，我们需要新鲜的鸡胸肉、酥脆的花生米、生姜、大蒜和洋葱。
children.notes: crispy peanuts: 香脆的花生; ginger, garlic and onions: 葱姜蒜
children.statement: “crispy” 是形容词，意为“脆的，酥脆的”。
children.explanation: crispy 用于形容油炸或烘烤食物酥脆可口的质感。
children.keywords: prepare, chicken breast, crispy peanuts, ginger, garlic, onions

children.text: First, cut the chicken into cubes and mix it with some cooking wine and salt.
children.cn: 首先，把鸡肉切成肉丁，并加入少许料酒和盐腌制拌匀。
children.notes: cut... into cubes: 切成小立方体/肉丁; cooking wine: 料酒
children.explanation: cut into cubes 比 cut into pieces 更加精准形象地描述了切丁的过程。
children.keywords: First, cut into cubes, mix, cooking wine, salt

children.text: Next, heat a little oil in a pot, adding the sliced ginger and garlic to bring out the aroma.
children.cn: 接着，在锅中加热少许油，放入姜片和蒜末以激发出香味。
children.notes: sliced: 切成片的; bring out the aroma: 激发出香气/爆香
children.statement: 现在分词短语 “adding the sliced ginger and garlic...” 在句中作伴随状语。
children.explanation: adding ... 现在分词作伴随状语，使句子结构更加地道流畅。
children.keywords: heat oil, in a pot, sliced ginger and garlic, bring out the aroma

children.text: Then, stir-fry the chicken quickly and pour in a special sauce made of soy sauce and vinegar.
children.cn: 然后，快速翻炒鸡丁，并倒入由酱油和醋调制的特制酱汁。
children.notes: pour in: 倒入; sauce made of...: 由……调成的酱汁（过去分词作后置定语）
children.statement: “made of soy sauce and vinegar” 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 sauce。
children.explanation: 过去分词短语 made of... 修饰前面的名词 sauce，表示调料成分。
children.keywords: stir-fry quickly, pour in, sauce made of, soy sauce, vinegar

children.text: Finally, toss in the roasted peanuts and cook for another minute.
children.cn: 最后，投入烤花生米，再翻炒一分钟即可出锅。
children.notes: toss in: 投入，放入; roasted peanuts: 炒/烤花生; for another minute: 再持续一分钟
children.statement: “toss in” 形象地表达了烹饪中下料翻拌的动作。
children.explanation: toss in 是地道生动的烹饪动词短语，意为“投入/拌入”。
children.keywords: Finally, toss in, roasted peanuts, cook for another minute

children.text: Meaning, Feelings & Cultural Value
children.cn: 情感意义与文化传播

children.text: Not only does this dish taste fantastic, but it also brings warmth and happiness to my family dinner table.
children.cn: 这道菜不仅味道极佳，而且为我家人的餐桌带来了温暖与幸福。
children.notes: Not only... but also...: 不仅……而且……（句首倒装句）; fantastic: 极好的，极佳的
children.statement: “Not only” 置于句首时，句子使用了部分倒装结构（does this dish taste）。
children.explanation: Not only 位于句首引导分句时，采用部分倒装语序，是极具亮点的进阶语法结构。
children.keywords: Not only, taste fantastic, but also, brings warmth and happiness, dinner table

children.text: By sharing traditional Chinese dishes with others, we can spread our wonderful food culture to the world.
children.cn: 通过与他人分享传统的中国菜肴，我们可以把我们精彩的美食文化传播到世界各地。
children.notes: By doing sth.: 通过做某事（方式状语）; spread ... to ...: 将……传播到……
children.statement: “By sharing” 在句中作方式状语。
children.explanation: 介词 by + 动名词短语作状语，表示达成目标的方式与途径。
children.keywords: By sharing, traditional Chinese dishes, spread, food culture to the world
